subject.title: chore(autoreview): sync hardened org review defaults

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the canonical autoreview interface that removes four reviewer engines and changes the default Codex model to Sol/high?
rationale: The implementation is correct and canonical, but merging deliberately changes existing internal CLI choices and default review behavior; repository history cannot decide whether OpenClaw maintainers accept that compatibility impact.

options.title: Adopt canonical defaults
options.body: Merge the exact canonical tree and treat the removed engines and new Sol/high default as the supported organization-wide workflow.

options.title: Pause for compatibility plan
options.body: Keep the PR open until maintainers define a canonical migration or deprecation path for external scripts using the removed reviewer engines.

recommendation.title: Adopt canonical defaults
recommendation.body: Merge the exact canonical tree and treat the removed engines and new Sol/high default as the supported organization-wide workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent introduced the downstream skill and authored the merged canonical change, making him the strongest available owner for confirming adoption intent.
